task.ques: Find out the trade-in value for an iPhone 15 Pro Max in good condition on the Apple website.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Apple’s U.S. trade-in value for an iPhone 15 Pro Max in good condition is $455 toward a new iPhone, checked October 27, 2026.

Evidence: Apple’s estimator displays “Good News. Your iPhone 15 Pro Max qualifies for credit” and “Apple Trade-In Value: Good Condition — $455.” See final.png.
Source: https://www.apple.com/shop/buy-iphone/iphone-18-pro
Apple Trade In: https://www.apple.com/shop/trade-in
